A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the semantics of state-oriented OCL is defined in a way that it is possible to reason about currently active states in OCL constraints and to express state transitions.
we have defined the semantics of the OCL expressions in the context of UML Statecharts, and we have provided the proof that the semantics is sound with respect to the OCL standard.
state-oriented expressions are defined as a special type of OCL expressions that are evaluated with respect to the current state of a Statechart.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the OCL 2 proposal is not sufficient for this purpose and we provide a formal semantics for a subset of OCL 2 that is sufficient to reason about UML Statecharts.
the semantics of state-oriented OCL can be defined in terms of a new kind of OCL expressions called state-oriented OCL (SO-OCL).
the proposed semantics allows for the integration of Statecharts in the OCL standard and thus enables to formulate more precise constraints in OCL.
